findings.title: Replace the new whole-NUPPT body equality with operational readers
findings.contract: public-exceptions.md General freeze/representation discipline: a machine gets public run/coin/field contracts, not a raw machine-body alias; X10 requests owner field/run readers.
findings.evidence: The new theorem equates the entire ofPolyTimeUniform NUPPT value to the ofPolyTime constructor specialization. It is used in three downstream proof lists to expose that construction before reading its output.
findings.smallest_repair: Use existing NUPPT.output_ofPolyTimeUniform / runAtL_ofPolyTimeUniform (and existing coin/advice readers) at those sites; remove the new body-equality interface. Publish an ordinary operational reader only if a precise existing contract is insufficient.
findings.mathematical_limit: No counterexample or machine-behavior change was found; this is the explicit API discipline, not a mathematical unsoundness claim. Native applicability of the proposed existing readers is not checked here.

same_chosen_machine_source_analysis.source_substitution_only: Every changed occurrence replaces hf by ((polyTimeComputable_iff f).1 hf), with no other body edit after whitespace normalization.
same_chosen_machine_source_analysis.owner_reader: ClassNP/PolyTime.lean:75–78 has exactly the unchanged existential predicate body and proof Iff.rfl.
same_chosen_machine_source_analysis.reason: hf and the reader-extracted proof inhabit definitionally equal propositions. Lean proof irrelevance identifies those proof arguments; repeated Classical.choose/choose_spec therefore select the same M/Ct/ct, not merely an equivalent machine. Other data/cost/advice fields are literal-identical.
